svg.text: Split architecture: stock FluidNC on ESP32 (motion) + ESP32-4827S043 ESP32-S3 (operator HMI) over UART. Supersedes docs/superseded-wiring_diagram.svg.
A · MAINS, E-STOP AND ROUTER POWER
Router contactor: coil A1/A2 driven by the 5 V relay module (GPIO 4). Contact L1→T1 feeds the router socket.
E-stop breaks L to both the PSU and the contactor,
so it removes lift power and router power together.
E-stop is hardware only — no GPIO, no firmware path.
N is common to PSU and router socket.
PE → enclosure · lift frame · router socket.
Contactor rated ≥2× router nameplate + arc suppression (PWR-03).
PWR-01 · PWR-04 · star-ground at the PSU
⚠ PSU must be 24–36 V. NOT 48 V — TB6600 absolute max ≈40–42 V (DEV-01 constrains §2.1's range).
5 V budget: HMI panel + backlight ≈0.5 A, MPG ≈40 mA, relay ≈70 mA → size ≥2 A.
stock FluidNC · all machine definition in config.yaml · ELE-02
Hard limits, homing, probe and soft
limits are enforced here — never in
Active HIGH — NC switches idle LOW.
with no HMI involvement at all.
HLTNC TB6600 + NEMA 23 · DEV-01 accepted deviation from ELE-01
⚠ Tie PUL+/DIR+/ENA+ to +3.3 V, NOT +5 V.
With a 5 V common the ESP32's 3.3 V high leaves 1.7 V across the input opto —
above its ~1.2 V LED drop, so it never fully turns off. Causes missed steps at
rapid, which under DEV-01 is silent depth error. 3.3 V common → true 0 V off,
≈8 mA on. Fallback if steps are missed at speed: 74HCT245 buffer driving 5 V.
ELE-04 · MOT-04 · MOT-05 · MOT-06 · one circuit per input
10k×100nF ≈ 1 ms RC — ELE-04 met in hardware, covers contact bounce.
Accepts either switch type, unchanged config
Mechanical NC, COM→GND idle LOW · limit HIGH
Inductive NPN NC idle LOW · limit HIGH
Both fail safe: a cut signal wire — or a cut 24 V supply
to the inductive sensor — floats HIGH and faults the machine.
⚠ NPN only. A PNP sensor sources 24 V into the GPIO.
LJ12A3-4-Z/BY = NPN NC (required). Any /A… suffix is PNP.
The 10k + clamp survives it; a bare pin does not.
G33 HOME (bottom) G25 TOP G32 PROBE
Shielded twisted pair, shield grounded at controller end only, routed clear of motor cable.
ESP32-4827S043 · 4.3" 480×272 RGB parallel (ILI6485) · GT911 touch · ELE-11
Acts as a GRBL sender: emits $J= jogs,
reports. It enforces no limit itself.
Link loss cannot start motion, cannot
block a stop, and leaves the hardware
No level shifting on this link.
Every safety input stays on FluidNC.
⚠ Level shifting IS required here — the ESP32-S3 is not 5 V tolerant.
The legacy value was true, assuming PC817 optos. A divider, 74LVC245 or
two-stage 74HCT14 are all non-inverting. Wrong value = wheel counts backwards.
80 mm dial = 2.51 mm rim travel per detent (60 mm dial would be 1.88 mm).
6 buttons · short/long press = 12 functions · split across both boards
BIT CHANGE → exit + force re-probe · ZERO → set zero here
PRESET → save current height · STOP → soft reset (0x18)
STOP is on FluidNC G21, not here.
feed_hold_pin acts with no HMI involvement, so it halts
motion even if the S3 crashes or the UART drops. The other
five need HMI state (NVS presets, Z0 validity, cycle FSMs).
⚠ STOP is a feed hold — NOT an E-stop.
E-stop = mains-rated red mushroom on yellow (block A).
STOP = flush round button. Mount them well apart —
two red mushrooms with different behaviours is dangerous.
Foot switch stays on FluidNC G13 (macro0_pin) — it initiates motion, so it must not cross the link.
